content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Sport on ESPN in Africa this festive - What to watch on DStv, Disney+ in December</title><link>https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/50571229/sport-espn-africa-festive-watch-dstv-disney+</link><description>From Thanksgiving NFL showdowns, to Christmas Day NBA action, and Boxing Day football, ESPN Africa has the festive season covered with a packed line-up of live sport, on channels across the continent and Disney+ in SA.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:34:45 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2025/1203/r1584273_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Draymond Green swats back at online critics, fuels Warriors' win over Celtics</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50570668/vocal-green-defensive-stop-buzzer-fuels-warriors-win</link><description>After reinforcing his career​ accolades earlier in the day on social media, Golden State Warriors forward Draymond Green closed out an 88-87 win over the Boston Celtics on Sunday with a last-second defensive stop and rousing celebration from the veteran.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:58:53 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1123/r1750046_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Which NBA players have the most triple-doubles of all time?</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/47987750/which-nba-players-most-triple-doubles-all</link><description>Russell Westbrook holds the NBA record for most triple-doubles in a career. See who else joins him on the list.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 04:20:20 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0220/r1617781_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Wariors down the Celtics at home</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50569693/wariors-celtics-home</link><description>Wariors down the Celtics at home</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 05:04:59 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/2026/1122/e056091cf0dc454cb22755ae8e95a6221389/e056091cf0dc454cb22755ae8e95a6221389.jpg" /></item><item><title>Karl-Anthony Towns has 30 points and 13 rebounds as Knicks beat Pacers 113-106</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401910034</link><description>— Karl-Anthony Towns had 30 points and 13 rebounds, Jalen Brunson added 22 points, and the New York Knicks beat the Indiana Pacers 113-106 on Sunday night to extend their winning streak to five games.</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 04:03:33 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401910034.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Indiana Pacers vs. New York Knicks: Game Highlights</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50569439/game-highlights</link><description>Indiana Pacers vs. New York Knicks: Game Highlights</description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 03:47:16 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/wsc/2026/1123/642db86c-1d4f-4f55-9cbd-d26e3ca98216/642db86c-1d4f-4f55-9cbd-d26e3ca98216.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
